verdict.rationale: Drata documents its own trust center: a SafeBase Trust Center with branding and URL setup, a Trust Center Analytics Dashboard, and API-based trust center management aimed at accelerating security reviews. That supports a hosted trust center, but the evidence consists of article titles and one-line claims, with no detail on what the trust center shows or how documents are gated. Missing for 10: evidence of live control status display, certification/report sharing, click-through NDA gating, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a sales lead, I get a hosted public trust center — live control status, certifications, and reports shared under click-through NDA — that closes security reviews before they start

citations.quote: Accelerate security reviews and trust assurance. Automate questionnaires and manage your trust center programmatically.
